title: Notify the scheme of construction workers and certify their service
what: Employers notify the Long Service Corporation within 7 days when a worker starts building and construction work in NSW, and give a certificate of each worker's service every year and when they leave.

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry Long Service Payments Act 1986 (NSW)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Long Service Payments Act 1986 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 16A Employer to notify Corporation of employment of workers An employer who employs a worker under a contract of employment must notify the Corporation of that employment within 7 days after the worker commences to perform building and construction work in New South Wales under that contract.

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Long Service Payments Act 1986 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 20 Contract of employment workers—certificates of service to be supplied by employers (1) An employer who employs, under a contract of employment, a worker shall— (a) within 1 month after 30 June in each year, furnish to the Corporation a certificate of service in respect of the worker for the year immediately preceding that 30 June,

reach.condition: if it employs workers in the building and construction industry as the state scheme defines it

sources.title: Building and construction industry worker registration long service leave
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: Building and construction industry employers need to register workers who are doing eligible building and construction work in New South Wales.

confidence_note: Quoted from the Act on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft. The scheme is also funded by a long service levy on building work (s 34), paid by the person for whom the work is done; that is a separate obligation, to be recorded as its own family.

assessment.summary: Employers must register with the industry's portable long service leave scheme, report workers' service and pay a levy.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
